description.value: L'Atelier Pâtisserie is a French bakery in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, founded in 2015 to bring the flavours of southern France—particularly Marseille and Provence—to the city. The shop specialises in laminated pastries, artisanal breads made with organic flour, and a rotating menu of seasonal specials and gourmet sandwiches. It has been featured in local media and is a well-established neighbourhood fixture for fresh-baked goods and light meals.
